resolved: Fixed: the sole earlier issue was the inaccurate package-wide claim in the shared hajek docstring. SAP/P009c/Defs/Part1.lean:80 now describes the zero extension; lines 81-83 limit the support guarantee to positive complete/paired populations and allow arbitrary off-domain values in HajekExtension statements. It no longer claims that all Hajek results require supported nonempty arms. The Bernoulli nonvacuity instance independently verifies why that distinction matters.
